ImranR98/Obtainium.releaseNotes:
## What's Changed
* By @ImranR98 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3393
    * Keep marked-updated versions across incomplete package loads (#3215)
    * Clear the installing state promptly after an external-installer cancel (#3091)
    * Fix self-hosted Gitea/Forgejo URL standardization (#3290)
    * Label the app tile actions node for TalkBack (#3398)
    * Improve TalkBack labels and app icon semantics (#3398)
    * Honor the detail-page update setting for size probes (#2988)
    * Keep universal APKs when filtering by architecture (#3349)
    * Refresh stale English placeholders in translations (#3397)
* Translation: Update hu.json by @summoner001 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3394
* Translation: Update ru.json by @solokot in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3395
* Translation of untranslated strings and grammatical corrections  by @Kevinr99089 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3399
* Update ja.json by @bluefly000 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3396
* Update zh.json translations by @Jursin in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3401
* Various items by @ImranR98 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3402
* Use a dark launch theme on Android TV (#281) by @ChaliceChore in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3404
* Retry transient Shizuku permission checks during batch installs (#3403) by @ImranR98 in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3405

## New Contributors
* @ChaliceChore made their first contribution in https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/pull/3404

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/ImranR98/Obtainium/compare/v1.7.0...v1.7.1

adityasaini404/PadhteRaho-Apk.releaseNotes:
# 🚀 PadhteRaho v1.1.0 — Roadmaps Update

A new learning update is here! 🎉

This version introduces the **Roadmaps** section, helping students follow a structured learning path for different programming languages and IT skills.

## ✨ What's New

### 🗺️ Roadmaps

* Added a dedicated **Roadmaps** section.
* Category-wise learning roadmaps.
* Step-by-step learning paths for different programming languages.
* Roadmaps for various IT and technical skills.
* Beginner-friendly structure to help students understand what to learn next.

### 📚 Courses

* Improved course organization.
* Category-wise courses with separate playlists.
* Easier navigation between learning content.

### 🎨 UI & Improvements

* Improved user experience.
* Minor UI improvements.
* Performance and stability improvements.
* Bug fixes.

## 📥 Installation

1. Download the latest APK below.
2. Install the APK on your Android device.
3. Open PadhteRaho and explore the new Roadmaps section.

## 📌 Previous Version

If you are already using an older version, install this version to get the latest features and improvements.

---

### 👨‍💻 Developed by

**Aditya Saini**

Happy Learning! ❤️

## v0.118.3 - 2025-05-22 10:47

**Commit history:** [`v0.118.2...v0.118.3`](https://github.com/termux/termux-app/compare/21c0d51f...v0.118.3)

<details>
<summary>Changelog</summary>

### Changed

- **!** Remove `TERMUX_APP__BUILD_DATA_DIR` as a different naming scheme will be used for build variables and rename `TERMUX__ROOTFS` to `TERMUX__ROOTFS_DIR`. ([`849e6b10`](https://github.com/termux/termux-app/commit/849e6b10))

##  

 



### Fixed

- Bump `org.lsposed.hiddenapibypass:hiddenapibypass` to `6.1` to fix crash on Android 16 QPR1. Related commit https://github.com/LSPosed/AndroidHiddenApiBypass/commit/9efadf06. Related commit https://android-review.googlesource.com/c/platform/libcore/+/3380841. Related commit https://cs.android.com/android/_/android/platform/libcore/+/0dc31afe. Closes [#4556](https://github.com/termux/termux-app/issues/4556). ([`fda17afa`](https://github.com/termux/termux-app/commit/fda17afa))  

- Declare `MANAGE_EXTERNAL_STORAGE` as it being added in Termux:API version `0.51.0` is revoking the storage permission of Termux app after updates and sometimes later. Related issue [#4486](https://github.com/termux/termux-app/issues/4486). ([`23756528`](https://github.com/termux/termux-app/commit/23756528))  

- Add explicit `serialVersionUID` to `Serializable` classes like `ReportInfo` and `TextIOInfo`. Reading `ReportInfo` with `Bundle.getSerializable()` by `ReportActivity` is triggering exception when default algorithm is used for `serialVersionUID` in Termux:API plugin app when error notification created in `ResultReturner.returnData()` by `TermuxPluginUtils.sendPluginCommandErrorNotification()` is clicked. Related issue https://github.com/termux/termux-api/issues/762. ([`4f033b34`](https://github.com/termux/termux-app/commit/4f033b34))  

---

 

</details>
